data_product_description: PDPI provides practices with insight into their prescribing patterns and costs, enabling comparison against national and local benchmarks. It supports performance management using data limited to prescribers directly linked to a practice.
data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
PDPI provides information on a practice’s prescribing habits and costs. This enables a practice to compare and manage their prescribing performance against national and commissioner or provider comparators.

The PDPI extract only contains data for prescribers that are directly attached to a practice.
